verdict.rationale: AngelList documents a few background automations. An HRIS/payroll integration automatically terminates employees in AngelList when they are terminated upstream. Automated system checks feed the Health Checks dashboard. Pre-approved Equity Blocks remove per-grant board approvals. These are fixed, vendor-defined behaviors, not automations the user can design and run autonomously. missing for 10: user-configurable automation/workflow builder, scheduled or trigger-based custom jobs, agentic AI automations, public API (OpenAPI probe 404s), independent corroboration.
